snippet.title: StarDrift Delivery - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Launch Trailer for StarDrift Delivery, a 3D shoot 'em up action roguelike game developed by Infernitz. Players will soar through the cosmos to destroy asteroids, deliver packages, and survive at all costs. StarDrift Delivery is available now for PC (Steam).
